title: Jazzy Smoky Canadian Bread Casserole
description: A yeasty, gooey casserole with golden syrup and a smoky kick, perfect for kids and kosher families
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with butter or non‑stick spray.
In a saucepan, melt butter over medium heat; stir in golden syrup, smoked paprika, liquid smoke, salt, and pepper until well combined.
Pour the sauce over the bread crumbs in a large bowl; stir until crumbs are evenly coated and slightly moist.
Transfer the crumb mixture to the prepared baking dish, pressing down to form an even layer.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese evenly over the crumb layer.
Bake for 20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the crumbs are golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
Serve warm, optionally with a side of fresh fruit or a simple salad.
